infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LineMap Pro uses the camera to photograph poles, handholes and cable plant for mapping.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LineMap Pro records the GPS location of each photo to place it on the map.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LineMap Pro can import existing field photos into a project.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LineMap Pro uses the microphone so you can label nodes by voice.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: LineMap Pro converts your voice into node labels and notes.
